easy:mcq:1.stem: A printer makes $30$ pages in $5$ minutes at a constant rate. How many pages will it make in $6$ minutes?

distractorNotes.A: Divided by the time twice: the rate per minute was already found.
distractorNotes.C: An arithmetic slip: redo the last computation carefully.
distractorNotes.D: Multiplied the total by the new time without finding the rate per minute first.

solution: Find the unit rate: $30 \div 5 = 6$ pages per minute.
Multiply by 6 minutes: $6 \times 6 = 36$.
